text.p: Tropical cyclone 08B, with winds of 55 mph, is located in the Bay of Bengal near 14.1N/87.0E and is moving off to the west at 5 mph. This system is expected to take a more west-northwesterly track over the next few days and make landfall somewhere in northeastern India sometime on either late Tuesday or Wednesday. Moderate to heavy rain, gusty winds, localized flooding, and mudsldes can be expected as this storm moves inland and dissipates. Shipping and boating will continue to be threatened by this system until it moves inland.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
